NAME
correct_spelling - correct spelling mistakes in a given text

SYNOPSIS
correct_spelling(text)

DESCRIPTION
The correct_spelling function takes a string input containing text with spelling mistakes and returns the corrected version. For example, given the input "The amber fox is verry brite.", the function will return "The amber fox is very bright." The function identifies common spelling errors and replaces them with the correct spellings to enhance readability and accuracy.
